description: Multi-Provider Architecture + Expedia & Hotels.com — define BrowserProvider interface, refactor executor to use provider registry, add Expedia and Hotels.com providers

userStories.title: Define BrowserProvider interface and registry
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a shared BrowserProvider interface and a URL-based registry so the executor can dispatch to any site adapter without knowing which site it is.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/booking-autopilot/providers/types.ts with BrowserProvider interface containing: id (string), matchesUrl(url), setup?(page, context, trace), getStageSignals(page, url, text) returning ProviderStageSignals, fillGuestForm?(page, profile, helpers, trace), fillPaymentForm?(page, profile, helpers, trace), getBotPatterns?()
ProviderStageSignals interface defined in types.ts with fields: searchResults (bool), hotelDetail (bool), guestDetailsStep (bool), paymentStep (bool)
Create lib/booking-autopilot/providers/registry.ts exporting getProvider(url: string): BrowserProvider | null and requireProvider(url: string): BrowserProvider (throws if not found)
Create lib/booking-autopilot/providers/index.ts that re-exports getProvider and requireProvider from registry
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Pure new files — no existing code touched. RpaHelpers type can be imported from stagehand-executor or temporarily typed as 'unknown' until US-003 cleans up imports.

userStories.title: Wrap booking-com.ts in BrowserProvider interface
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the existing Booking.com code wrapped in the BrowserProvider interface so it plugs into the registry with zero behavior change.
acceptanceCriteria: Export a bookingComProvider object from lib/booking-autopilot/providers/booking-com.ts implementing BrowserProvider
matchesUrl: reuses existing isBookingComUrl()
setup: contains search-bar-disable logic + cookie-injection logic (extracted from stagehand-executor.ts — do NOT delete from executor yet, copy it)
getStageSignals: wraps existing getBookingComStageSignals(), maps result to ProviderStageSignals shape
fillGuestForm: wraps existing fillBookingComGuestForm()
fillPaymentForm: wraps existing fillBookingComPaymentForm()

getBotPatterns: returns the bot-detection strings array (currently hardcoded in executor: 'something went wrong', 'access denied', 'checking your browser', 'show us your human side', 'bot or not', 'we can't tell if you're a human', 'please type the numbers you hear')
bookingComProvider registered in registry.ts
All existing exports in booking-com.ts remain untouched (backwards compatibility)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Do NOT remove any existing exports or inline executor code yet — that happens in US-003. This story is additive only.

userStories.title: Refactor executor.ts to use provider registry
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the executor to dispatch all site-specific operations through the provider registry so there are zero hardcoded isBookingCom checks remaining.
acceptanceCriteria: Import getProvider from lib/booking-autopilot/providers/index.ts at top of stagehand-executor.ts
Replace all resolveProviderContext() / resolveProviderIdForUrl() calls with const provider = getProvider(currentUrl ?? raw.url())
Bot-detection check uses provider?.getBotPatterns?.() ?? [] merged with unreachable-site strings
setup block replaced with await provider?.setup?.(raw, stagehand.context, trace)
Stage signals block uses await provider?.getStageSignals(raw, currentUrl, pageText) instead of providerGetBookingComStageSignals()
Guest form block calls await provider?.fillGuestForm?.(raw, p, bookingComHelpers, trace)
Payment form block calls await provider?.fillPaymentForm?.(raw, p, bookingComHelpers, trace)
Zero occurrences of the string 'isBookingCom' as a standalone boolean variable declaration in stagehand-executor.ts (grep check: grep -n 'const isBookingCom' stagehand-executor.ts returns empty)
Booking.com end-to-end flow still reaches paused_payment on a real test run (manual verification)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Most complex story — touches 47 locations in executor. Work methodically: replace one block at a time, typecheck after each. Keep the provider-specific helper functions (providerFillBookingComPaymentForm etc.) in booking-com.ts for now — the BrowserProvider wrapper calls them internally.

userStories.title: Implement Expedia provider — stage signals and URL matching
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an Expedia BrowserProvider so the executor can detect stages on Expedia hotel pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/booking-autopilot/providers/expedia.ts implementing BrowserProvider
id: 'expedia'
matchesUrl: returns true when url includes 'expedia.com' (case-insensitive)
getStageSignals detects searchResults: url contains '/Hotel-Search' or '/hotels' (case-insensitive)
getStageSignals detects hotelDetail: url contains '/h/' followed by digits, or url contains '/hotel/' and NOT '/Checkout'
getStageSignals detects guestDetailsStep: url contains '/Checkout' AND page contains guest name / email input fields (use page.evaluate to check DOM)
getStageSignals detects paymentStep: url contains '/Checkout' AND payment card number input is visible (use page.evaluate)
getBotPatterns returns: ['show us your human side', 'bot or not', "we can't tell if you're a human", 'please type the numbers you hear']
setup is a no-op (return immediately)
expediaProvider registered in registry.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: No payment form yet — that is US-005. Stage signal detection may need adjustment after real browser testing in US-007.

userStories.title: Implement Expedia payment form RPA
userStories.description: As a user, I want the system to pre-fill my card details on Expedia's checkout page so I only need to enter the CVV to complete the booking.
acceptanceCriteria: Add fillPaymentForm to expediaProvider in expedia.ts
Inspect Expedia checkout DOM: determine if payment fields are in a cross-origin iframe or inline — log findings to trace()
If iframe: use page.frameLocator() to access fields (same pattern as fillBookingComPaymentForm in booking-com.ts)
Fill cardholder name field with profile.card_name
Fill card number field with profile.card_number
Fill expiry date field with profile.card_expiry
Stop before CVV/CVC field — do not fill it
After filling, run a verification pass: log which fields have values and which are empty
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference fillBookingComPaymentForm() in booking-com.ts for the iframe locator pattern and verification approach. Key difference from Booking.com: Expedia may use inline DOM instead of cross-origin iframe — check first with page.evaluate() to count visible card inputs before assuming iframe.

userStories.title: Implement Hotels.com provider
userStories.description: As a user, I want to book hotels on Hotels.com using the same automation so I can use reward nights.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/booking-autopilot/providers/hotels-com.ts implementing BrowserProvider
id: 'hotels-com'
matchesUrl: returns true when url includes 'hotels.com' (and NOT 'expedia.com')
getStageSignals detects searchResults: url contains '/search'
getStageSignals detects hotelDetail: url matches pattern /hotels\.com\/ho\d+/ (e.g. /ho123456) and NOT checkout
getStageSignals detects guestDetailsStep: url contains '/checkout' AND guest info fields visible
getStageSignals detects paymentStep: url contains '/checkout' AND payment card input visible

fillPaymentForm: fills cardholder name, card number, expiry — stops before CVV (Hotels.com and Expedia share Expedia Group payment infrastructure — reuse expedia.ts fillPaymentForm logic with Hotels.com-specific selectors if different)
getBotPatterns returns same patterns as Expedia (same bot detection)
hotelsComProvider registered in registry.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Hotels.com is Expedia Group — checkout DOM is nearly identical to Expedia. Start by copying expedia.ts and adjusting URL matchers. If payment selectors are identical, extract shared logic to a helper in a new file lib/booking-autopilot/providers/expedia-group-payment.ts.

userStories.title: End-to-end test — Expedia
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify the full Expedia booking automation works before marking the feature complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Run a full booking automation test on Expedia: search for a hotel in NYC, select a room, proceed through checkout
Live log shows stage transitions: listing → room_selection → checkout_form → payment_gate (no 'unknown' stages stuck for more than 1 iteration)
Final status is paused_payment — 'Ready for payment — enter CVC'
Live browser view shows payment page with cardholder name, card number, and expiry pre-filled
Document any Expedia-specific quirks found (stage detection mismatches, DOM differences) by appending to progress.txt
Fix any bugs found during test run before marking this story passes: true
userStories.notes: This is a real browser test — requires a valid Booking.com-style test setup. Use AI_LOOP_FULL=true. If stage detection fails, iterate on expedia.ts getStageSignals() until it reliably detects each stage.

userStories.title: End-to-end test — Hotels.com
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify Hotels.com booking automation works end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: Run a full booking automation test on Hotels.com: search for a hotel, select a room, proceed through checkout
Live log shows stage transitions: listing → room_selection → checkout_form → payment_gate
Final status is paused_payment — 'Ready for payment — enter CVC'
Live browser view shows payment page with card fields pre-filled
Document Hotels.com-specific quirks in progress.txt
Fix any bugs found before marking this story passes: true
userStories.notes: Run after US-007 is complete. If Hotels.com payment DOM is identical to Expedia, this should pass with minimal changes.
